background: Deutsche Bank is Germany's largest bank, a universal bank with a large investment bank, a corporate bank, German retail banking under the Deutsche and Postbank brands, and the DWS asset manager.
synthesis: Rated A+ on average across all three, the weakest of them at A, two on a positive outlook and one on a stable outlook, after a two-notch upgrade by one of the three on 12 May 2026, the bank's ratings are on an upward path. The ratios do not match that momentum: CET1 of 13.9%, leverage of 4.5% and LCR of 140% are all in the bottom quarter of EU and Nordic banks, and NSFR of 118% is below the median. None of the ratios has moved materially over the past four periods to 30 Jun 2026. The flagged news is a steady flow of litigation and settlements, the newest on 25 Sep 2026 concerning allegedly forged contracts.
